t: Fractional Trading | Interactive Brokers LLC
s: Start small with no need to buy a whole share. Grow a diverse portfolio across global markets. Keep your cash working instead of sitting idle. Fractional shares represent portions of a whole share of a company’s stock or an exchange-traded fund (ETF). Instead of purchasing an entire share, investors can buy a fraction, allowing them to invest amounts that align with their financial goals.
